title: SDK yardstick scrum log — Week of Oct 27 2026
body:
Context: informal weekly scrum focused on SDK quality gates, quickstarts refresh, and sample app burn-in. We ran the first full "yardstick" smoke pass against the new quickstart templates and collected telemetry for token cost, latency p50/p95, and cold-start cost on Redwood Hosted. Meeting: 10/27 09:30 PT (30m). Attendees: Aisha (notes), Marcus, Sofia, Tom, Priya, and two contractors (Eden, Raul).

Agenda:
- Quickstart yardstick results (smoke pass)
- SDK surface regressions (breaking changes reported)
- Samples garden: flaky tests & CI timeouts
- Docs edits: getting-started + environment variables section
- Action items / owners / follow-ups

Notes:
1) Quickstarts: ran 5 templates (chat, simple-gen, embeddings, rerank, code). Chat quickstart showed a token-cost regression ~12% vs baseline for long-turn threads (seed prompts used: qs/yardstick/long-thread-01). Root cause likely related to default streaming buffer size change in SDK v0.9.3. Marcus will revert buffer heuristic in a patch branch to validate. Linked PR: github#492.

2) SDK regressions: Two breaking notices surfaced in community slack — function-calling param behavior when call args omitted. Tom reproduced, filed ENG-2148. Short-term mitigation: doc callout + compatibility shim in 0.9.4. Longer-term: add unit tests in parser module to lock behavior.

3) Samples garden: flaky e2e in the samples-runner on Linux-latest CI, intermittent failure at `samples/quickstart/auth` step due to token refresh retry logic hitting rate limits. Sofia to add retry jitter + local dev script to reproduce. Pin candidate fix branch: samples/fix/retry-jitter.

4) Docs and quickstarts: Priya updated the environment variables section but we still need explicit KMS examples for Private deployments. Action: Priya to draft KMS snippet and Aisha to review. Also add a short troubleshooting FAQ for common onboarding errors (401s, CORS in hosted demos).

5) Telemetry and metrics: we captured p50/p95 and token counts; early observation — prefix KV cache hit-rate is 18% lower for chat quickstart than expected. Hypothesis: sample prompts include varied system messages; need canonicalization. Action: run a targeted mini-eval to measure canonical prompt variants (Eden/ Raul).

Decisions made:
- Hold SDK 0.9.4 release until buffer heuristic revert validated and function-calling shim implemented.
- Canary quickstart rollouts to internal org only for one week after fixes.

Action items (owner — ETA):
- Marcus: open revert PR for streaming buffer heuristic + perf run (2026-10-29).
- Tom: add parser unit tests and submit compatibility shim PR (2026-10-30).
- Sofia: add retry jitter to samples-runner, reproduce flaky auth locally, update CI matrix (2026-11-02).
- Priya: KMS snippet draft + troubleshooting FAQ (2026-10-31).
- Aisha: review KMS snippet + coordinate canary cohort list (2026-11-01).
- Eden & Raul: mini-eval for prompt canonicalization, produce heatmap of cache-hit vs prompt-variant (2026-11-03).

Open questions / risks:
- How many existing customer integrations rely on the previous streaming buffer behavior? Need a quick survey on telemetry client usage to estimate impact. (ask SEs).
- If token-cost regression persists post-revert, we may need to roll quantization profile adjustments for chat models — this is more invasive.

Notes-to-self / working thoughts:
- Consider adding an SDK compatibility page to docs with a short matrix: Breaking/Behavioral changes per minor release. Could be a simple table in Confluence first.
- Quickstarts should include a small "cost smoke" check that runs a 1-min smoke script and reports token counts locally to avoid surprises.

Next meeting: quick follow-up sync Thu 10/29 09:00 PT to review PR results (15m).

Raw snippets / commands used (for reproducibility):
- yardstick runner: `scripts/yardstick/run.sh --templates chat,gen,emb,rerank,code --output=tmp/yard-10-27`
- perf probe: `python perf/probe.py --target quickstart-chat --samples=200`

Attachments (local): yardstick/raw-10-27.log, samples-ci/flaky-auth-trace.txt (uploaded to shared drive folder).

End of log.
